blocks.title: Erotic / Sexual Tension Progression
blocks.body: E08 L210 ka cliffhanger E09 P1 mein resolve hota hai: Dhika remote call par towel aur bra ki camera-view presentation change karti hai; Bobby ki private impression-related thought ko actual dialogue se alag rakhna zaroori hai. Saturday P3–P5 mein Dhika aur Chotu ka E06 aftermath conversation, apology aur source-described new kiss occur hota hai. Shaam ko Raj–Sharmi dinner mein Dhika ki usual clothing/social shyness, Raj ki reaction, public teasing aur later Dhika ka spontaneous hug apni independent social route banate hain. John–Dhika marriage teasing remains active. Yeh alag scenes/relationships hain; koi ek intimacy act doosre ko future permission nahi deta.

blocks.title: Reader-Known Secrets & Dramatic Irony
blocks.body: P1 mein Bobby ke towel versus bra preference ka ek hissa uski inner thought hai, jo woh poora bolta nahi; Dhika uski implication infer karti hai. Dhika Chotu ko delivery ke liye specifically hope karti hai, lekin prior E06 consent violations uski private reassurances se historical canon mein delete nahi hote. Saturday Raj ki visible social response ko John aur Sharmi ki comments ke saath contrast karke dikhaya jaata hai; private thoughts aur public jokes alag. John–Sharmi flirt banter aur Raj–Dhika warm greeting ko affair label nahi diya gaya.

blocks.title: Major Turning Points & Why They Matter
blocks.body: P1: E08 video-action cliffhanger ka actual disclosure aur Bobby ke saath call ki closure. P2: John–Dhika Friday outing mein Sharmi/Raj ka Saturday dinner invitation. P3–P4: Chotu ki E07 distance ki direct explanation aur reconciliation conversation; earlier E06 stop requests ko erase nahi karna. P5: kiss-history question se new source-described kiss and emotional state change. P6–P7: Dhika's unusual outside outfit and Raj reaction. P8–P9: house tour then wine/tea seating create two social conversation pairings. P10–P11: Sunday horror-film plan and reciprocal married-couple teasing.

blocks.title: Open Hooks / Unresolved Questions
blocks.body: Chotu ki renewed outward ease E06 boundary problem ko long-term kaise affect karti hai? E09 mein explicit accountability discussion ki limit kya hai? Sunday late horror movie invitation accepted hai, film scene abhi future hai. Swiss physics competition aur Dhika mentor possibility predecessor episodes se open hain. Raj aur Sharmi ke social interactions aage kaise develop honge? Actual future relationship state source evidence ke bina assume nahi karna.

blocks.title: Reader Possibilities — NON-CANON
blocks.body: Dinner invitation aur Sunday movie scheduling documented facts hain; possible future private attraction/jealousy sirf reader speculation hai, established affair ya permission nahi. Chotu ki verbal guilt aur Dhika ke consolation ke baad future emotional processing uncertain hai. Bobby ki private response ko baaki characters ki knowledge mein automatically add na karein.

blocks.title: Episode-End Reader Carry-Forward
blocks.body: E09 L228 par Saturday late car ride mein John aur Dhika dono Sharmi/Raj ki social closeness par playful teasing continue karte hain. Sunday 10 p.m. horror outing planned hai, yet has not happened. Raj–Dhika spontaneous hug occurred and was observed/discussed; this is not a romance. Chotu interaction reconciliatory hai but E06 stop requests still retained. Future E10 ko yahi endpoint inherit karna hai.
